senses.en_definition: An act of biting; a bite inflicted by a person, animal, or insect.
senses.ms_definition: Cengkaman dengan gigi untuk menggigit.
senses.nuances: 强调咬这一动作或事件。马来语也常用 gigitan nyamuk 表示蚊子叮咬，不要求叮咬者在生物学上具有牙齿；食物的‘一口’通常用 sesuap 或一次动作表达，不宜一概译为 gigitan。

senses.zh_definition: 被咬或叮咬后留下的印痕、伤口或皮肤反应。
senses.en_definition: A mark, wound, or skin lesion left by a bite.
senses.ms_definition: Bekas digigit.
senses.nuances: 强调咬后的结果，与第一义的动作形成区别。bekas gigitan 明确指咬痕；luka gigitan 明确指咬伤，并非每个 gigitan 都会破皮。

etymology.historical_story: Gigitan is formed within Malay from gigit, ‘bite’, and the noun-forming suffix -an. Its two dictionary meanings preserve a useful connection between an action and its visible result: the bite itself and the mark it leaves. Everyday mosquito talk makes this connection especially memorable, because the same word can describe both the event and the itchy spot afterward.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 顺着 gi-gi-tan 念：gigit 是‘咬’，加 -an 就把镜头定格成‘一次咬’或‘留下的咬痕’。

etymology.historical_story: Gorilla Grodd first appeared in The Flash number 106 in 1959. DC presents him as a highly intelligent gorilla with telepathic powers and ambitions of domination. His name enters Malay discussion through comics and related entertainment. This is a history of a fictional character's name, rather than evidence of a Malay lexical root. [DC character history](https://www.dc.com/characters/gorilla-grodd)

senses.en_definition: A ghoul: a supernatural being in Arabic tradition, often depicted as changing shape and misleading or frightening travellers in desolate places.
senses.ms_definition: Makhluk dalam tradisi Arab yang dikisahkan menjelma dalam pelbagai rupa serta mengganggu atau menyesatkan pengembara di tempat sunyi.

etymology.historical_story: Ghul represents Arabic ghūl, a creature with a long narrative life across Arabic and Persian traditions. Accounts describe beings that change shape, haunt lonely places, or threaten travellers. These traditions vary considerably, so the familiar English image of a corpse-eating ghoul should not automatically replace the meaning intended in a Malay religious discussion. [Encyclopaedia Iranica](https://www.iranicaonline.org/articles/gul/)

senses.ms_definition: Roda bergigi atau susunan roda bergigi yang memindahkan kuasa serta mengubah kelajuan atau arah gerakan.
senses.nuances: 机械语境可指单个齿轮，也可指传动齿轮组；单个齿轮还可明确称为 roda gear。释义依据 [DBP PRPM：gear](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=gear)。

etymology.historical_story: Gear entered Malay as an English technical loanword and became an ordinary word of workshops, machinery, and driving. Malay grammar treats it as a usable base: menggear means to use gears, while penggearan names gearing. Its mechanical meaning remains central; English uses referring broadly to clothing or equipment should not automatically be transferred into Malay.

word_family.gloss: 细嘴乌鸦，亦称 gagak paruh rampai

senses.zh_definition: 乌鸦；通常指羽毛黑而有光泽、叫声粗哑的鸦属鸟类。
senses.en_definition: A crow, typically a black bird of the genus Corvus with a harsh call.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis burung dendang yang berbulu hitam berkilat dan berbunyi garuk.
senses.nuances: 日常单独使用 gagak，通常指乌鸦。词包中的 gagak paruh besar 为 Corvus macrorhynchos，gagak hutan 或 gagak paruh rampai 为 Corvus enca。动物量词用 ekor。

senses.zh_definition: 在鸟名 gagak gunung 中，指蓝绿鹊，学名 Cissa chinensis。
senses.en_definition: In the bird name gagak gunung, the common green magpie, Cissa chinensis.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis burung yang juga disebut gagak gunung, dengan nama saintifik Cissa chinensis.
senses.nuances: 这是完整鸟名中的专门义。该鸟属于鸦科，但不是通常所说的黑色乌鸦；翻译时应保留物种区别。[马来西亚生物多样性资料](https://www.mybis.gov.my/sp/21124)

senses.zh_definition: 在鸟名 gagak paruh emas 中，指黄嘴蓝鹊，学名 Urocissa flavirostris。
senses.en_definition: In the bird name gagak paruh emas, the yellow-billed blue magpie, Urocissa flavirostris.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis burung yang juga disebut gagak paruh emas, dengan nama saintifik Urocissa flavirostris.
senses.nuances: 属于鸟类名称中的专门义，不表示任何长着黄色嘴的乌鸦。paruh emas 字面为“金色的喙”，英文物种名中的 yellow-billed 指黄色喙。

collocations.en: the tail of a yellow-billed blue magpie

etymology.historical_story: Malay proverb traditions make the crow more than a bird name. Gagak bersuara murai describes someone judged unattractive who nevertheless has a beautiful voice and good manners. The contrast preserves an older cultural image of the crow, while giving modern learners a reason to discuss the proverb without repeating its appearance-based judgment. [Linguistic discussion](https://publisher.unimas.my/ojs/index.php/ILS/issue/download/180/88)

etymology.historical_story: Gus illustrates how a short dictionary headword can live mainly inside a familiar expression. DBP records sekali gus for doing everything at the same time, including paying a whole year's fees together. Its cultural usefulness lies in gathering separate obligations into one occasion. This describes its documented use without assigning an unverified historical origin. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=150348&keyword=gus)

etymology.historical_story: In Malay tailoring, gunting names both the scissors and the cut they produce, linking a tool with its visible result. The same everyday object also enters gunting dalam lipatan, an image of betrayal from within. A hidden pair of scissors becomes a memorable cultural warning: harm can come from someone apparently on your own side. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=gunting)

word_family.gloss: 使成为奇数；使人觉得奇怪

senses.zh_definition: 与平常情形不同而显得奇怪、反常或不寻常的。
senses.en_definition: Strange or unusual; different from what is normal or expected.
senses.ms_definition: Aneh, pelik atau berlainan daripada kebiasaan.
senses.nuances: 可形容行为、声音、现象或处境，未必涉及危险或超自然现象。直接形容某个人 ganjil，容易让人觉得是在贬低对方；形容具体行为通常更得体。

senses.zh_definition: 整数不能被二整除的；奇数的。
senses.en_definition: Of an integer: not divisible by two without a remainder; odd.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak genap, iaitu tidak dapat dibahagikan dengan dua tanpa baki; gasal.
senses.nuances: 数学用语，与 genap（偶数的）相对。此义不带评价色彩；ganjil 描述数字的奇偶性质，不表示计算有误。

etymology.historical_story: Ganjil already appears with the numerical meaning 'odd, not even' in John Crawfurd's 1852 Malay dictionary. Modern Malay also uses it for something strange or unexpected. An unpaired object offers a useful bridge between these meanings, although that image is a learning interpretation rather than a demonstrated account of the word's origin. [Historical dictionary](https://wallace-online.org/converted/pdf/1852_Crawfurd_WS5.2.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Gadai belongs to the vocabulary of borrowing against possessions. Its dictionary expressions preserve several parts of the transaction: a rumah gadai is the place, a surat gadai records the pledge, and menebus gadai describes redemption. Figurative expressions extend the same image to staking one's life, dignity, or principles. No specific ultimate origin is asserted here.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 gadai → 当铺场景：交出金饰、拿到借款、之后赎回；声音记词，交易链条记义。

etymology.historical_story: Gwen comes from Welsh gwen, the feminine form of gwyn, associated with meanings such as white and blessed. It functions as an independent given name and as a short form of names including Gwendolen and Gwenllian. When used in Malay conversation, it remains a personal name rather than acquiring those Welsh meanings as ordinary Malay vocabulary. [Name history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/gwen).

etymology.historical_story: Gali connects physical work with intellectual discovery. Its dictionary family covers digging holes, taking things from the earth, and investigating ideas. etymology.historical_story: Gerudi is listed among Malay borrowings from Tamil in research published by DBP. Its place among practical tools illustrates how language contact can carry everyday technical vocabulary. Malay has integrated the word into its own morphology: menggerudi names the action, while penggerudian names the process, extending the tool's vocabulary to industrial drilling. [DBP: Tamil loanword research](https://dev.dbp.my/index.php/jurnalbahasa/ms/article/download/3911/4255/29373)

etymology.historical_story: In Malay literary and commemorative language, gugur brings falling leaves and fallen warriors into the same expressive field. The physical image also helps learners connect its dictionary senses involving premature fruit drop and lost rights. These connections provide a semantic memory map; they do not establish which meaning appeared first historically.

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries capture laughter as more than a single emotion: gelak can name both laughing and its sound. Expressions such as gelak sumbing describe an insincere laugh, while tergelak marks laughter that escapes involuntarily. This vocabulary offers a cultural miniature of how speakers distinguish shared amusement, spontaneous reactions, and socially awkward smiles. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=gelak)

etymology.historical_story: The retail name Giant has a specifically Malaysian commercial history: the company's account traces its beginnings to a provision shop in Sentul Pasar in 1944. This makes the name familiar in local shopping conversations. Its commercial identity must nevertheless be distinguished from the ordinary English word meaning an exceptionally large being or thing. [Source: Giant](https://giant.sg/giants-history).

etymology.historical_story: Golden is an English formation from gold and the adjective-forming suffix -en. Its meanings connect the precious metal with its distinctive colour, then with excellence, favourable opportunities and flourishing periods. DBP records the word in its English–Malay dictionary, providing Malay equivalents rather than establishing it as a native Malay adjective. [Sources: Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/golden), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=golden)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: gold 是金，golden 像金一样：可以指材料、颜色，也可以比喻机会珍贵；马来语常用 emas 或 keemasan。

etymology.historical_story: Goddamn joins God with damn and preserves the form of a religious curse. Collins dates the expression to late Middle English. It later developed uses as an emotional exclamation and intensifier, sometimes without a literal religious intention. That shift does not remove its potential to offend: the historical wording remains recognisable even when a speaker means only frustration or emphasis. [Source: Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/goddamn).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: God + damn：从“诅咒”联想到强烈咒骂，再记住它也能强调程度；damn 末尾的 n 不发音。

etymology.historical_story: Malay gosok connects several familiar activities through friction: brushing teeth, polishing surfaces, and ironing clothes. Its figurative use also describes stirring somebody into anger. This is a useful semantic connection, rather than proof of a particular historical sequence. The consulted dictionary establishes these meanings but supplies no donor-language etymology. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=241100&keyword=gosok)

etymology.historical_story: Here, g belongs to the Rumi alphabet used to write Malay. Its dictionary identity is a letter rather than an ordinary vocabulary word. Learning it involves two separate facts: the letter is called ji, while its usual consonant value in Malay words is /ɡ/. Keeping these apart helps prevent spelling and reading confusion.

etymology.historical_story: As an English personal name, Greg is a shortened form of Gregory. Gregory passed through Latin Gregorius from Greek Gregorios, associated with being watchful or alert. etymology.historical_story: Ghost is inherited English vocabulary, traceable to Old English gast, referring to spirit or soul. Its newer conversational verb turns disappearance into a social metaphor: someone vanishes from communication as though becoming a ghost. This explains the connection between supernatural stories and unanswered messages, but it does not establish the word as an officially adopted Malay borrowing. [Etymology](https://www.etymonline.com/word/ghost)

etymology.historical_story: English gym developed as a shortened form of gymnasium. In Malaysian usage, the English spelling can appear alongside Malay sentences, while DBP records gim as the Malay abbreviation of gimnasium. The useful learning distinction is therefore between an English form used in mixed conversation and its established Malay counterpart, rather than between a root and a Malay affix. [English source](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/gym), [Malay source](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=gim)

etymology.historical_story: Gargamel reaches Malay conversation as a character name from Peyo's Smurfs universe, rather than as a Malay descriptive word. The franchise portrays him as a wizard obsessed with capturing Smurfs, often accompanied by his cat Azrael. These recurring stories provide the cultural association learners need; they do not establish a Malay derivation or a general dictionary meaning. morphology.pattern_note: 名词 gi 作为完整借词记忆。表示“去”的 gi 由 pergi 脱落开头音节形成，并非去掉一个生产性前缀；方言中 lagi 也可截短为 gi。下列词族仅关联“去”这一义项。

senses.zh_definition: 去；前往；离开。为 pergi 的非正式缩略形式。

senses.ms_definition: Bentuk singkat pergi dalam percakapan: bergerak ke sesuatu tempat atau meninggalkan sesuatu tempat.
senses.nuances: 常见于熟人聊天和短信；正式作文、公文及一般工作汇报应写 pergi。该缩略形式也见于马来语短信研究。[DBP 研讨会论文](https://cvsupyanhussin.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/2005-sms-supyan-hussin-seminar-dbp.pdf)

senses.ms_definition: Kependekan lagi dalam dialek Pulau Pinang, seperti dalam ungkapan sat gi yang bermaksud sebentar lagi.
senses.nuances: 须按方言和整句判断；sat gi 里的 gi 不是动词“去”，也不是名词“酥油”。DBP 明确认可此槟城方言用法。[DBP：方言用法说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=gi)

etymology.historical_story: The cooking noun gi belongs to the same borrowing tradition as English ghee: an early Malay dictionary identifies it as a Hindustani word for clarified butter. The everyday verb has a separate history, arising through shortening pergi. Their identical sound is therefore accidental. In conversation, a destination points to 'go', while ingredients and cooking point to the butter. [Historical Malay dictionary](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/9/94/An_abridged_Malay-English_dictionary_%28romanized%29_%28IA_afu7967.0001.001.umich.edu%29.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Grid illustrates how one borrowed technical word can organize very different pictures. A map uses intersecting lines, a spreadsheet uses rows and columns, and a graph uses reference lines. Malaysian electricity writing also uses grid for interconnected power infrastructure. These related patterns offer a useful cultural and conceptual story without assuming that every sense entered Malay together. Sources: [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=313048&keyword=grid), [OpenDOSM](https://open.dosm.gov.my/ms-MY/data-catalogue/electricity_supply).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到 grid，就在脑中铺开一张“格子网”：图上是网格，表里是行列，供电系统里是互联的电网。

senses.zh_definition: 声音强烈而轰隆作响的；如雷鸣般响亮的。
senses.en_definition: Loud and rumbling or roaring, like thunder.
senses.ms_definition: Kuat dan menderu-deru bunyinya seperti guruh.
senses.nuances: 常形容掌声、欢呼声、飞机或瀑布的声音；强调持续或滚动般的强大声势。表示发出这种声音的动作时常用 bergemuruh。[DBP：gemuruh](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=gemuruh)

senses.zh_definition: 因害怕、忧虑或面对重要场面而心跳加快、紧张不安的。

senses.nuances: 常见于上台、面试和比赛前的紧张；不是医学诊断，也不必然达到恐慌的程度。[DBP：gemuruh](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=gemuruh)

etymology.historical_story: DBP's morphology reference presents gemuruh as guruh, meaning thunder, with the infix -em-. The word offers a vivid bridge between the outside world and inner experience: a crowd can sound thunderous, while someone awaiting a public appearance can feel a similarly overwhelming disturbance within. Both meanings are recorded in Kamus Dewan. [DBP《Morfologi》](https://jendeladbp.my/app/uploads/woocommerce_uploads/2025/04/eDigital_Morfologi-qnsczr.pdf)；[DBP 词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=gemuruh)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 guruh＝雷：外面雷声轰隆，是 gemuruh；心里像打雷一样怦怦跳，也是 gemuruh。

etymology.historical_story: English goo names sticky material and can also criticize excessive sentimentality. The American Heritage Dictionary suggests that it may be shortened from burgoo, but marks that explanation as uncertain. DBP includes goo as an English headword in its bilingual dictionary. Neither fact establishes an independent Malay origin or confirms its status as a standard Malay borrowing. [American Heritage Dictionary](https://ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=goo)

etymology.historical_story: The packet does not establish whether this token represents the surname Gates or the English plural gates. In Malay writing, an English surname retains its identity rather than acquiring Malay affixes. Bill Gates provides a documented example: he co-founded Microsoft with Paul Allen in 1975. The surname’s deeper origin is not established here. Source: [Gates Foundation](https://www.gatesfoundation.org/about/leadership/bill-gates).

etymology.historical_story: Gangster is the English form corresponding to standard Malay gengster. The contrast illustrates how borrowed vocabulary can acquire a local spelling while its English form remains visible in mixed-language writing. Malaysia's parliamentary transcription guide explicitly pairs gengster with gangster, showing that spelling choice matters when spoken material is converted into formal Malay text. [Parliamentary transcription guide](https://repositori.parlimen.gov.my/bitstream/123456789/4179/1/BUKU-%20PANDUAN%20PENYEDIAAN%20VERBATIM%20PENYATA%20RASMI%20HANSARD%20-%20FINAL%209%20JAN%202025.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: In Batman fiction, GCPD is formed from the initial letters of Gotham City Police Department. DC's own character descriptions use both the full institutional name and its abbreviated form. Its Malay appearance is therefore best understood as the retention of a fictional English proper-name initialism, rather than Malay affixation. Without the original corpus context, this expansion remains a contextual interpretation. [DC reference](https://www.dc.com/characters/renee-montoya).

etymology.historical_story: Genggaman is transparently formed from genggam with the Malay noun-forming suffix -an. Its meanings follow a familiar bodily pathway: a closed hand, what the hand holds, and the power to retain something. Malay expressions about authority and victory extend that physical image, making an abstract situation understandable through the experience of holding something securely.

etymology.historical_story: Google began as a search project developed by Larry Page and Sergey Brin at Stanford. Its earlier name was Backrub. The replacement name plays on googol, the mathematical term for one followed by one hundred zeros. That association expressed the ambition to organise an enormous amount of information. The brand later also became a conversational verb. [Source: Google](https://about.google/company-info/our-story/)

etymology.historical_story: Geledah brings the idea of searching into cupboards, bags and buildings: the searcher examines what is inside to find a particular object. The dictionary also records menggeladah as a related alternative form. Its modern family includes the searcher and the act of searching. The available evidence supports these relationships but does not establish a deeper historical origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按 ge-le-dah 三拍想象“打开、翻找、查遍”：不是随便看一眼，而是为了找东西而翻查。

etymology.historical_story: As a character name, Groot belongs to American popular culture rather than Malay word formation. The character debuted in comics in 1960 and entered the Marvel Cinematic Universe in Guardians of the Galaxy in 2014. These appearances explain a recognizable referent for the spelling, but do not establish which referent the supplied token intended. See [LEGO’s character history](https://www.lego.com/en-us/themes/marvel/characters/groot).

senses.zh_definition: 发电机；将机械能等其他形式的能量转化为电能的机器。

senses.nuances: 日常提到 generator，通常指发电设备，尤其是备用发电机。马来语同义术语为 penjana 或 penjana elektrik；它与 generator 是术语对应关系，并非同一马来语词根的派生关系。[DBP：generator](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=generator)。

etymology.historical_story: Generator belongs to an international technical vocabulary with an ultimate Latin source meaning a producer or begetter. Its machine sense preserves that productive image: something brings an output into being. Malay treats generator as a whole borrowed noun, while penjana provides a corresponding Malay term. The packet does not identify the immediate borrowing route. [Oxford: word origin](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/generator).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 generator 想成“产生输出的机器”：日常多产生电，技术语境也可产生气体或蒸汽。记住马来语开头读 /ɡe/。

senses.zh_definition: 英语词：监护人；负责照顾、保护他人并承担相应责任的人，法律语境中尤指依法承担监护职责者。
senses.en_definition: A person responsible for another person's care and protection, especially someone legally entrusted with that responsibility.
senses.ms_definition: Padanan bahasa Melayu bagi kata bahasa Inggeris ini ialah penjaga, khususnya seseorang yang bertanggungjawab terhadap jagaan dan perlindungan orang lain.
senses.nuances: guardian 在 DBP 英马词典中是英语词头，不能据此认定为正式马来语借词。标准马来语通常用 penjaga；本条马来语释义是对应义说明。输入未提供音节及爪夷文，故保留 null。监护意义须结合文件语境判断，不能一概等同于临时照顾者；wali 也不能在所有语境中替换 penjaga。以下搭配列标准马来语对应表达。参见 [DBP 英马词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=pelindung)及 [Cambridge 英马词典](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-malaysian/guardian)。

senses.zh_definition: 英语词：守护者；保护某人、群体、事物或价值，使其免受伤害或损失的人或机构。
senses.en_definition: A person or institution that protects or preserves someone or something.
senses.ms_definition: Padanan bahasa Melayu bagi makna ini ialah pelindung, iaitu pihak yang melindungi atau memelihara seseorang atau sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 此义强调保护或维护，不必存在法律上的监护关系。标准马来语按对象选用 pelindung 或其他更具体的称谓；不能把所有 guardian 都译成保安人员 pengawal keselamatan。以下搭配为马来语对应表达。参见 [DBP：guardian 的 pelindung 义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=pelindung)。

etymology.historical_story: English guardian came through Anglo-French gardein, a word for a keeper or protector. Its history connects it with guard and, through a related French form, warden. The broad idea of watching over someone developed a specific legal application to a person entrusted with another's care. This is English word history, rather than evidence of a Malay derivation. [Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/guardian)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到开头 /ɡɑːd/，联想到英语 guard“守护”：guardian 就是承担守护责任的人。马来语对照记忆：照顾人用 penjaga，强调保护用 pelindung。

etymology.historical_story: Georgia brings together names with different histories. The American state was named for King George II. The country’s native name is Sakartvelo, and the origin of its Western name remains debated. As a personal name, Georgia is a feminine form related to George. Shared spelling therefore does not establish one common origin. [State history](https://www.dncr.nc.gov/blog/2024/01/23/north-carolina-georgia-q-33); [Country-name history](https://ishi.pitt.edu/news/place-news-why-georgia-endonyms-and-exonyms-country-names); [Personal name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/georgia).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Georgia 先分三格记：Tbilisi 对应格鲁吉亚国家，Atlanta 对应美国佐治亚州，通讯录里的 Georgia 对应人名乔治娅。

etymology.historical_story: Getaran is transparently formed from getar with the noun-forming suffix -an. DBP records both the root and its derivatives, linking everyday trembling with descriptions of vibration. Literary language extends the same movement into emotional experience, as in getaran jiwa. This is a documented morphological and cultural connection, rather than evidence for a particular ancient borrowing. [DBP reference](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=getar).

etymology.historical_story: Girls is the regular English plural of girl. The singular is recorded in Middle English as girle, with meanings including child and girl; its deeper origin remains uncertain. The final -s marks number, rather than a Malay derivation. Its appearance inside a Malay conversation should therefore be distinguished from an established Malay dictionary headword. [American Heritage: girl](https://ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=GIRL)

etymology.historical_story: The supplied evidence does not establish an ultimate etymology for gaduh. Its documented meanings nevertheless offer a useful cultural picture: public disturbance, interpersonal conflict, and private unease share one form. DBP also records regional meanings involving haste and effort, showing why locality matters when interpreting an apparently familiar word. [Source](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=gaduh)

etymology.historical_story: Going belongs to English and is formed from go with the ending -ing. Its presence in a Malay-language collection does not by itself establish Malay borrowing: quotations and mixed-language conversations can also introduce English forms. Establishing its status in this particular dataset would require the original passages. No separate Malay origin is established here.

morphology.formula: 英语 got to → gotta；不是马来语词缀派生
morphology.pattern_note: 英语口语中 got to 连读形成 gotta；所列音标采用英式英语读法。数据包的 is_root 仅表示未作马来语词缀分析，不代表英语词源上的原生词根。

word_family.gloss: 英语对应短语；在 have got to 中表示必须
英语表达：必须、不得不；不是马来语派生词

senses.zh_definition: 英语非正式表达，表示“必须、得、不得不”，相当于 have got to；不是标准马来语词。
senses.en_definition: A nonstandard English representation of spoken '(have) got to', expressing necessity or obligation.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk bahasa Inggeris tidak baku bagi ungkapan '(have) got to' yang menyatakan keperluan atau kewajipan; padanannya dalam bahasa Melayu ialah 'mesti', 'perlu' atau 'kena' mengikut konteks.
senses.nuances: 限英语或语码混用语境。此处 verb 指其英语动词性功能，不是马来语词类认证；马来语释义为编辑说明，并非 DBP 原文。不能把 gotta 当作马来语 kata bantu 使用。参见 [Cambridge Dictionary：gotta](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/gotta)。

senses.zh_definition: 英语非正式表达，用于强调根据情况作出的强烈推断，相当于“一定是、肯定得是”。
senses.en_definition: An informal English expression of strong inference, equivalent to 'must' or 'have got to'.
senses.ms_definition: Ungkapan bahasa Inggeris tidak baku yang menyatakan kesimpulan dengan keyakinan tinggi; boleh dipadankan dengan 'pasti' atau 'tentu' mengikut konteks.
senses.nuances: 例如 gotta be 强调判断，不一定表示行动义务。马来语应按意思译为 pasti 或 tentu，而不是一律译为 mesti。参见 [Cambridge Dictionary：gotta](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/gotta)。

etymology.historical_story: Gotta records the sound of English got to in rapid speech, especially within have got to. Its spelling brings conversational pronunciation into writing. When it appears inside a Malay sentence, the useful distinction is between an English insertion and a Malay derivative: its letters contain no Malay prefix or suffix. [Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/gotta)

morphology.pattern_note: 按输入包保留 gitu 为独立词项；它在来源上是 begitu 的口语缩略形式。这里省去的 be- 不能据此认定为能产前缀 ber- 的变体。

senses.zh_definition: 那样；如此；以所说或所示的方式。
senses.en_definition: Like that; in that way; a colloquial shortening of begitu.
senses.ms_definition: Singkatan bahasa percakapan bagi begitu, iaitu dengan cara atau dalam keadaan seperti itu.
senses.nuances: 用于回指前面的话、动作或情境。可单独回应，也可出现在 kalau gitu 等表达中。释义据 [DBP：gitu](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=gitu) 整理。

senses.zh_definition: 那么；达到所指的数量、大小或程度。
senses.en_definition: That much, that big, or to that degree, as indicated by context.
senses.ms_definition: Seperti itu dari segi banyak, besar atau darjahnya; segitu.
senses.nuances: 程度或数量需要由上下文确定，不能单独理解为固定数目。与 segitu 的关系见 [DBP：gitu](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=gitu)。

etymology.historical_story: Gitu illustrates how everyday speech can shorten a familiar expression while preserving its meaning. DBP identifies it as a colloquial shortening of begitu and also records the related quantity expression segitu. Its presence in a dictionary documents actual usage; it does not remove the distinction between conversational language and formal writing.

senses.zh_definition: 哎呀；天哪。表示惊讶、赞叹或轻微懊恼的英语感叹语。

senses.nuances: 实际词类是 interjection（感叹词），此处依给定词类集合归入 particle。在马来语交谈中属于英语语码转换，不能因此视为规范马来语词。马来语释义为编写的解释，并非 DBP 官方引文。英语词义见 [Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/gosh)。

etymology.historical_story: Gosh developed in English as a softened substitute for God, allowing speakers to express strong feelings while avoiding a direct religious oath. Its modern function is usually emotional rather than devotional. When inserted into a Malay conversation, it remains an English interjection rather than acquiring Malay prefixes or suffixes. [Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/gosh), [linguistic study](https://benjamins.com/catalog/pbns.302.04dow)

senses.zh_definition: 十分喜欢、爱好某种活动或事物，常表示较稳定的兴趣或偏好。

etymology.historical_story: The supplied evidence does not establish a deeper etymology for gemar. Its dictionary family nevertheless reveals a cultural connection: DBP illustrates related forms through hikayat, syair, and traditional Malay songs. The same root links personal enjoyment with literary audiences: menggemari describes liking, kegemaran a favourite pursuit, and penggemar an enthusiast. [DBP: gemar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=gemar)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ge-mar 连着兴趣清单记：“gemar membaca，gemar berenang”＝爱读书、爱游泳；再串起 gemar → kegemaran（爱好）→ penggemar（爱好者）。

morphology.formula: ∅ + Gardner → Gardner (nama khas; tiada pengimbuhan bahasa Melayu)
morphology.pattern_note: 整词作为姓氏识别；不按马来语词缀拆分。所列音标是该英语姓氏的一种常见英式读法，并非经核定的马来语读音。is_root 表示本条不作马来语派生分析。

etymology.historical_story: English Greece is recorded from around 1300 and derives from Latin Graecia. Earlier English also used Greklond. The name illustrates how one country can acquire different names through different linguistic traditions: English uses Greece, while standard Malay uses Yunani. Neither spelling is a Malay affix formation. [Sources: Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Greece), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=greek).

etymology.historical_story: English gate descends from Old English geat, referring to a gate, doorway, or opening. Its airport meaning extends the idea of a controlled passage to aircraft boarding. Within Malay conversation, the English form can be inserted directly into a Malay sentence; DBP supplies context-sensitive Malay equivalents rather than treating every occurrence as the same kind of door. [Etymonline: gate](https://www.etymonline.com/word/gate), [DBP: gate](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=gate).

etymology.historical_story: Gangsa belongs to a Southeast Asian vocabulary of metalworking associated with Sanskrit kaṃsa, meaning bell-metal. Historical research records related forms in Old Javanese inscriptions concerning bronze and bronze workers. The connection between material and sound is memorable: the same metal tradition supplies drums, bells, and gongs, while modern sporting language uses gangsa for bronze medals. See [Nicolas's historical study](https://cdn.angkordatabase.asia/libs/docs/Nicolas_2011_Musical_Exchange_India_Sout-1.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: The international name behind Malay gorila has an unusual literary ancestry. New Latin gorilla draws on Greek Gorillai, a name preserved in an ancient account of a voyage around Africa. The account described hairy beings, but that description should not be treated as a reliable identification of the modern animal. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/gorilla)

senses.en_definition: The SI unit of absorbed dose of ionizing radiation, equal to one joule per kilogram; symbol Gy.
senses.ms_definition: Unit SI bagi dos terserap sinaran mengion, bersimbol Gy, yang bersamaan dengan satu joule tenaga yang diserap bagi setiap kilogram bahan.
senses.nuances: 此处采用马来西亚技术语境中有依据的单位义，参见 [马来西亚原子能机构考试资料](https://www.aelb.gov.my/v2/dokumen/pegawai-perlindungan-sinaran/Examination%20Question%20Samples%20-%20Certification%20of%20Radiation%20Protection%20Officer.pdf) 与 [NIST 单位说明](https://www.nist.gov/programs-projects/calibrations-water-calorimetry-primary-standards-absorbed-dose-water)。单位名通常小写 gray，符号写 Gy。英语颜色词 gray 的标准马来语对应词是 kelabu，不能据此把 gray 标为马来语颜色形容词；大写 Gray 也可能是姓名，须看上下文。

etymology.historical_story: The radiation unit gray commemorates Louis Harold Gray, a British scientist whose work helped establish radiation dosimetry. Its name preserves a researcher’s surname rather than describing a colour. This distinction matters in Malay: gray belongs to technical measurement, whereas the ordinary colour word is kelabu. Remembering the scientist helps keep these unrelated meanings apart. [European Nuclear Society](https://www.euronuclear.org/glossary/gray/), [Cambridge English–Malay Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-malaysian/grey)

etymology.historical_story: Gu brings an agricultural object into view: a wooden crosspiece joins two cattle so they can pull together. The dictionary also records a pair and a group or playing partner. Shared pairing provides a useful mnemonic, but does not prove their historical development. The separate gu in cikgu must likewise not be assigned the same origin without evidence.

etymology.historical_story: Gita is borrowed from Sanskrit gīta, meaning song. Its older literary character survives in Malay even though lagu is the ordinary everyday choice. The compound gita puja denotes a song of praise, while the familiar title Bhagavad-Gita preserves the same association with song in a distinct sacred-text tradition. [Etymology](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/gita#Malay); [DBP cultural examples](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=gita).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: gi-ta 可联想“吉他伴歌”：看到 gita 就想到歌声；gita 的意思是“歌”，乐器“吉他”则是 gitar。

etymology.historical_story: The noun gambar supplies the concrete image behind this verb: a picture makes something visible. Malay extends that image to descriptions that help listeners understand a scene and to scenes formed privately in the mind. Gambarkan retains these connections, whether a teacher requests a drawing or a friend invites someone to imagine a possibility.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: gambar 是“图像”：接 -kan，把对象变成看得见或想得出的图像——画出来、说清楚、想象出来。

etymology.historical_story: The spelling guang alone cannot establish a word history. It may occur in a romanized personal name, while Guang is also the title of a Malaysian film. Those uses do not identify the source token. Establishing its origin requires the original context and, where relevant, the Chinese character and tone rather than an attractive invented derivation.

word_family.gloss: 加倍；复制或重叠的过程

senses.zh_definition: 使数量、程度或力量加倍；使成为原来的两倍，或按语境指定的倍数增加。
senses.en_definition: Make a quantity, degree or amount twice as great, or increase it by a specified factor.
senses.ms_definition: Jadikan jumlah, banyak atau tahap sesuatu dua kali sebanyak asalnya, atau tingkatkannya mengikut gandaan yang ditetapkan.
senses.nuances: 常用于指令。单说 gandakan 数量时通常理解为加倍；gandakan usaha 也可泛指大幅加强努力，不要求精确量化。需要精确倍数时宜写成 jadikan tiga kali jumlah asal 等明确表达。词义参考 [DBP：ganda](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=315760&keyword=ganda)。

senses.zh_definition: 复制或重复某项内容，使出现相同的副本或再次出现的形式。
senses.en_definition: Duplicate or repeat something, producing another instance of the same content or form.
senses.ms_definition: Hasilkan salinan sesuatu atau ulangi sesuatu bentuk atau kandungan.
senses.nuances: 用于文件、文字及语言形式的复制或重复。文件份数应另行说明；若强调重新说一次，ulang 或 ulangi 通常更直接。

etymology.historical_story: Gandakan belongs to the Malay family built around ganda, a word associated with multiples and repetition. Adding -kan turns that idea into an instruction to cause an increase or repetition. The same family connects arithmetic, copying documents and kata ganda in grammar. These connections explain its present-day range without confusing it with the separate literary homonym ganda meaning fragrance.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: ganda＝倍，-kan＝使之如此：gandakan 就是“让它翻倍”。想象把一份材料变成两份。

etymology.historical_story: English gold continues Old English gold and belongs to an older Germanic word family. Its history connects the metal with brightness, while later uses extend its value to wealth, excellence and sporting victory. In Malaysian conversation, the English word may appear in mixed-language shopping or sports talk, although standard Malay uses emas. See [Etymonline: gold](https://www.etymonline.com/word/gold).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 gold 就先想“金”：是金属、金色还是金牌，再看语境；写标准马来语时换成 emas。

etymology.historical_story: DBP records gelandangan both independently and within the gelandang word family, where gelandang is marked as Indonesian usage. The related verb bergelandangan describes wandering without a purpose. These connections help explain the movement from an unsettled way of life to a label for people lacking stable housing or employment. etymology.historical_story: Godzilla comes from the Japanese name Gojira, conventionally explained as a blend of gorira, meaning gorilla, and kujira, meaning whale. The name evokes enormous size and strength. The creature first appeared in 1954 and became an international film icon; its name should be learned whole rather than analysed as Malay morphology. [TCM](https://www.tcm.com/articles/995339/the-origins-of-godzilla), [official film website](https://godzilla-anime.com/intro/)

etymology.historical_story: Gloria comes from the Latin word for glory. Its naming history includes Portuguese and Spanish Marian titles, connecting personal naming with Christian devotional language. Literary works later helped introduce the name to English-speaking audiences. This background explains its cultural associations, but a person's name alone does not establish their religion. See [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/gloria).

morphology.pattern_note: 后缀 -an 构成表示行为或其相关事物的名词。词根末尾 a 与后缀起首 a 分属两个音节，保留 go.da.an，不合并为一个 a。

senses.zh_definition: 诱惑；引人追求某种享受、利益，或做出违背原则之事的吸引力、事物或言语。

senses.ms_definition: Perihal menggoda atau sesuatu yang mendorong seseorang melakukan sesuatu, terutama perbuatan yang tidak baik.

senses.zh_definition: 使人心绪不宁或扰乱安宁的干扰、侵扰。
senses.en_definition: A disturbance or troubling influence that unsettles a person or disrupts their peace.
senses.ms_definition: Sesuatu yang menjadikan fikiran atau keadaan tidak aman atau tidak tenteram; gangguan.
senses.nuances: 此义常需由叙事、精神困扰或超自然题材的上下文明确；普通的噪声干扰通常直接说 gangguan。此义见 [DBP PRPM 所收《Kamus Pelajar》](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=godaan)。

etymology.historical_story: Godaan belongs to the Malay family built around goda and menggoda. The suffix -an lets the language name both the act of tempting and the thing that tempts. Its cultural range stretches from moral warnings about wrongdoing to playful complaints about delicious food, showing how a serious word can become lighthearted through context.

morphology.pattern_note: gigih 是双音节词根，不拆成 gigi + h，也不是重叠构词。派生名词 kegigihan 由 ke- + gigih + -an 构成，词根保持不变。

senses.zh_definition: 坚毅的；为实现目标持续努力，遇到困难也不轻易放弃的。
senses.en_definition: Persistent and determined in working towards a goal despite difficulties.
senses.ms_definition: Bersungguh-sungguh meneruskan usaha untuk mencapai tujuan walaupun menghadapi kesukaran.
senses.nuances: 通常具有褒义，突出面对困难仍持续努力，比 rajin 更强调坚持和韧性。在 berusaha dengan gigih 中，词根仍按形容词处理，由 dengan 引出方式成分。释义参照 [DBP PRPM：gigih](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=gigih)。

senses.zh_definition: 坚定不移的；牢牢坚持立场、信念或斗争目标的。
senses.en_definition: Resolute or tenacious in maintaining a position, belief, or cause.
senses.ms_definition: Teguh mempertahankan pendirian atau pegangan dan tidak mudah mengubahnya apabila menghadapi tentangan.
senses.nuances: 与第一义的区别在于，此义强调立场坚定，而不只强调工作努力。通常可译为坚定、顽强；语境不利时也可能接近固执，但不能一律等同 degil。PRPM 另列古旧同形词 gigih II，其派生形式 menggigih 表示发抖，不应与现代常用的坚毅义混淆。参见 [DBP PRPM：gigih](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=gigih)。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 称赞他人 gigih 通常是在肯定努力和毅力，适用于学生、同事及奋斗者。正式致谢可说 Terima kasih atas usaha gigih anda。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 熟人说 Gigihnya! 既可能真心称赞，也可能带轻微调侃，须结合语气判断。面对疲惫或受挫的人，宜肯定其具体努力，避免把坚持变成要求对方继续透支的压力。

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan marks gigih with Mn, identifying a Minangkabau connection. Its entry emphasizes firmness of heart and adherence to one's position, while Kamus Pelajar also highlights sustained effort towards a goal. These related meanings explain its usefulness in descriptions of determined students, workers and campaigners. The dictionary evidence supports this regional connection without establishing an exact borrowing date. See [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=gigih).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 跟着 gi-gih 的两拍，想象一步、再一步：遇到阻力仍向前，就是 gigih。它强调持续坚持，不只是某一天特别勤快。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词借入，不把词尾 -i 当作马来语后缀；三个音节，中间的 e 读 /ə/。采用标准音位式转写，未沿用输入候选中首音节的 [ɛ]。

etymology.historical_story: Malaysia's Department of Museums identifies galeri as a borrowing from English gallery. In Malay museum vocabulary, it names a room or building where exhibits and artworks are displayed. Its cultural setting is broader than paintings alone: a gallery may also present historical objects and material that tells a community's story. Source: [Department of Museums Malaysia](https://www.jmm.gov.my/en/node/1890).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: galeri 和英语 gallery 对照记：念 ga-le-ri，脑中走进一间挂满作品的展厅。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语虚构专名，整词记忆，不按马来语词缀拆分；通常写作 Gryffindor。所列 IPA 为英式英语读音；资料包未提供音节划分及爪夷文。

senses.zh_definition: 格兰芬多：《哈利·波特》中霍格沃茨魔法学校的四个学院之一，以重视勇气、胆识和决心著称。

senses.ms_definition: Nama khas bagi salah satu daripada empat rumah di Hogwarts dalam siri Harry Potter, yang mengutamakan keberanian dan keazaman.
senses.nuances: 这是虚构世界中的专有名词，不是表示“勇敢”的普通马来语词。资料包没有提供 DBP 释义；此处马来文为编写的说明性释义。headword.status 沿用指定输出标签，不代表 DBP 收录认证。常见短语属于专名组合。

etymology.historical_story: Gryffindor belongs to the fictional naming system of Harry Potter. Within the story, the Hogwarts house takes its name from its founder, Godric Gryffindor. Its lion emblem and scarlet-and-gold colours reinforce its association with courage. For Malay learners, it functions as an imported proper name rather than a word formed through Malay affixation. [Official Harry Potter Encyclopedia](https://www.harrypotter.com/fact-file/magical-miscellany/gryffindor)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Gryffindor 的声音分成 GRIF—fin—dor，联想门口一头红金色雄狮：格兰芬多学院。声音分组仅用于记忆，不是词源拆分。

morphology.pattern_note: gembira 首音节的 e 为 /ə/；加 -nya 后无辅音替换，ny 读 /ɲ/。-nya 的功能须按句式判断，可形成名词化表达或参与感叹结构，不应一律译成“他的”。所给爪夷文是基词 gembira；完整形式可写作 ݢمبيراڽ。音节可分析为 gem.bi.ra.nya，但数据包字段为 null。

senses.zh_definition: 多么高兴；真开心，用于突出喜悦程度的感叹表达。
senses.en_definition: How happy; so delighted, used in an exclamatory construction.
senses.ms_definition: Ungkapan seruan yang menyatakan darjah perasaan sangat suka atau girang, seperti dalam ayat 'Gembiranya saya!'
senses.nuances: 这里按表达的形容词核心标注词性；并非把整个感叹句当作独立词类。Gembiranya saya! 表达“我真开心！”，-nya 不指第三人称。教材也会从名词化角度分析相关结构。基词含义参见 [DBP：gembira](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=gembira)。

senses.zh_definition: 喜悦、高兴的状态或程度；依语境也可指某人的喜悦。
senses.en_definition: Happiness or the state or degree of being happy, sometimes associated with a person identified by context.
senses.ms_definition: Hal, keadaan atau darjah perasaan gembira yang dibendakan oleh -nya; orang yang mengalami perasaan itu ditentukan oleh konteks.
senses.nuances: dengan gembiranya 整个短语在句中作方式状语，意为“欢欢喜喜地”；其中 gembiranya 可按 kata pembenda 分析为名词化形式。不要把每个 -nya 都当作领属代词。基词在古典文学中还可涉及激昂、勇气或怒意，这些不是现代日常用法。[DBP《Pelita Bahasa》：-nya 的名词化用法](https://jendeladbp.my/app/uploads/woocommerce_uploads/2025/08/PB-9-2025-TERBIT-7yzukl.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Gembira is commonly connected with Sanskrit gambhīra, meaning deep or profound. The World Loanword Database cautiously classifies this connection as probable borrowing, rather than certain. Modern Malay centers on happiness, while older dictionary senses include heightened spirit and courage. Gembiranya adds Malay -nya; the complete form was not borrowed from Sanskrit. [World Loanword Database](https://wold.clld.org/word/71261840313158179)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gembira 记成“开心”，再听句尾 nya 像情绪扬起来：Gembiranya!＝“太开心啦！”这是语气联想，不是历史词源。

morphology.pattern_note: 本词无词缀。派生词 menggelung 中，meN- 在 /ɡ/ 前实现为 meng-，词根首辅音 g 保留。

senses.zh_definition: 绳索、藤条、金属丝等弯绕形成的圈、环或盘曲部分。
senses.en_definition: A loop, ring, or coil formed by something curved or wound around.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk melingkar atau melengkung yang terhasil apabila tali, rotan, dawai atau benda seumpamanya dibengkokkan atau dililitkan.
senses.nuances: 侧重环绕形成的形状；gulung 更常突出卷起的动作或卷成的整体。此处对应输入材料中的 gelung I；词典另列的吉打、吉兰丹方言同形词不应与本义混同。参见 [DBP PRPM：gelung](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=gelung)。

senses.zh_definition: 头发弯曲形成的卷、鬈曲部分，或盘绕成的发圈。
senses.en_definition: A curl or loop of hair, including hair coiled into a bun.
senses.ms_definition: Lengkungan atau lingkaran rambut, sama ada berupa ikal atau rambut yang dipintal dan disusun menjadi sanggul.
senses.nuances: gelung rambut 须依上下文译为发卷、发圈或盘发部分；明确指整个发髻时，sanggul 更直接。

collocations.en: a curl or loop of hair

senses.zh_definition: 计算机程序中按条件重复执行的一组指令所构成的循环。
senses.en_definition: A programming structure that repeatedly executes a set of instructions.
senses.ms_definition: Struktur dalam atur cara yang melaksanakan arahan tertentu secara berulang mengikut syarat yang ditetapkan.
senses.nuances: 计算机术语，对应英语 loop；与物理环圈共享循环往复的概念，但不指代码的外形。参见 [DBP PRPM：gelung I 及计算机术语](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=gelung+I)。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries connect gelung with the visible shapes of rope, rattan, wire, and curled hair. These everyday objects offer a concrete cultural setting for remembering the word without inventing an ancient origin. Computing terminology also uses gelung for a loop, giving the familiar circular image an abstract counterpart in repeated instructions. A specific earlier etymon is not established here.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 ge-lung 时，用手指绕一个圈：绳子成圈是 gelung，程序反复执行也是 gelung。

senses.zh_definition: 格雷戈尔：外来人名，见于 Gregor Mendel 等姓名；当前资料不足以确认其具有马来语普通名词义。

etymology.historical_story: Gandum is traced to Persian forms meaning wheat. Research on Malay loanwords identifies it in older Malay records, including Pigafetta's sixteenth-century vocabulary as gandun. The word therefore carries a history older than modern packaged flour. Its enduring meaning connects a traded grain with familiar Malaysian kitchen language such as tepung gandum. [Etymological study](https://www.researchgate.net/publication/360202447_ETIMOLOGI_KATA_PINJAMAN_SANSKRIT_TERPILIH_DALAM_BAHASA_MELAYU)

etymology.historical_story: Gerhana belongs to Malay's Sanskrit inheritance: Sanskrit grahaṇa also names an eclipse. Older Malay traditions associated eclipses with Rahu swallowing a heavenly body, giving the event a memorable narrative image. Modern Malay retains the inherited word while explaining the phenomenon through astronomy. Sources: [Maxwell's Malay manual](https://www.gutenberg.org/cache/epub/25604/pg25604-images.html), [DBP's Rahu reference](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=gerhana).

etymology.historical_story: Ga represents gallium, discovered in 1875 by Paul-Émile Lecoq de Boisbaudran through spectroscopy. Its name honours Gallia, the Latin name for France. The discovery was especially striking because Mendeleev had already predicted an element with similar properties, calling it eka-aluminium. The symbol preserves the opening letters of the international element name. [Discovery history](https://edu.rsc.org/elements/gallium/2020009.article), [Mendeleev's prediction](https://periodic-table.rsc.org/about).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Ga 看作 galium 的姓名牌：取开头两个字母，首字母大写、第二个小写。符号要认形；朗读时通常说 galium。

etymology.historical_story: Malay gen belongs to the international vocabulary of heredity. In 1909, Danish botanist Wilhelm Johannsen coined the term gene for hereditary units and distinguished genotype from phenotype. The term originally named inherited factors before their molecular nature was understood. Malay uses the compact form gen for this scientific concept. [NHGRI: The Word Gene Coined](https://www.genome.gov/25520244/online-education-kit-1909-the-word-gene-coined).

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 在职场或教育语境中，明确说 ghairah belajar 或 ghairah menjalankan penyelidikan，可突出积极投入；单独形容某人很 ghairah 容易引起歧义。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 避免对不熟悉的人或同事说 Saya ghairah melihat awak，这通常带有强烈的情欲意味。正式赞扬一般可用 bersemangat 或 berdedikasi。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 在职场或教育语境中，明确说 ghairah belajar 或 ghairah menjalankan penyelidikan，可突出积极投入；单独形容某人很 ghairah 容易引起歧义。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 避免对不熟悉的人或同事说 Saya ghairah melihat awak，这通常带有强烈的情欲意味。正式赞扬一般可用 bersemangat 或 berdedikasi。

etymology.historical_story: Ghairah comes from Arabic ghayrah, associated with jealousy and zeal. In Malay, its meanings extend across possessive jealousy, passionate desire, and intense enthusiasm. That range explains why a sentence about learning can sound positive while one about attraction can sound intimate. The activity or relationship named in the sentence helps listeners identify the intended meaning. [Etymology reference](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/ghairah).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ghairah 联想成心里的火：烧向学习是热情，烧向爱人是爱欲，烧向情敌可能是醋意；靠语境判断。

headword.data_note: 这是英语词，不能据此标为官方马来语词。syllables 原样保留输入，但 various translations 不是有效音节标注；英语 give 为单音节。以下提供英语核心义与马来语对应表达，未虚构马来语官方释义或爪夷文。排名沿用输入。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语整词，不按马来语词缀拆分。词尾 e 不发音；过去式 gave、过去分词 given 为不规则变化。giving 加 -ing 时去掉词尾 e。

senses.zh_definition: 把某物交给或赠予他人。
senses.en_definition: To transfer or present something to someone.
senses.ms_definition: Menyerahkan atau menghadiahkan sesuatu kepada seseorang.
senses.nuances: 英语义；马来语通常用 memberi、memberikan 或 menyerahkan。以下为核心义归纳，依据 [Merriam-Webster：give](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/give)，并非 DBP 对马来语词 give 的释义。搭配的 ms 字段提供马来语对应表达。

senses.zh_definition: 提供帮助、信息或资源；给予机会、许可或权利。
senses.en_definition: To provide something or grant a benefit or permission.
senses.ms_definition: Menyediakan bantuan atau mengurniakan peluang, izin dan hak.
senses.nuances: 不一定涉及实物转移；马来语译法由宾语决定，不能把每个 give 都机械替换成同一种结构。

senses.zh_definition: 与动作名词搭配，表示进行某项活动、作出某种动作或表达。
senses.en_definition: To perform an action or present an event.
senses.ms_definition: Melakukan tindakan atau mengadakan sesuatu acara.
senses.nuances: 属于英语轻动词用法；马来语常用更具体的动词，如 menyampaikan、mengadakan、tersenyum，译法随搭配变化。

senses.zh_definition: 使人产生某种感受或处境；产生某种结果或产物。
senses.en_definition: To cause an experience or produce a result.
senses.ms_definition: Menimbulkan keadaan atau menghasilkan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 包括带来希望、造成疼痛和产出某物等用法；应按结果关系选择马来语动词。

senses.zh_definition: 在压力下弯曲、松动或失去支撑；也指作出让步。
senses.en_definition: To yield under pressure, physically or figuratively.
senses.ms_definition: Melentur, menjadi longgar atau mengalah akibat tekanan.
senses.nuances: 此义不能译成“给予”。give way、give in、give up 等多词表达须分别判断，不能仅靠本义推导。

senses.zh_definition: 材料受力时可伸展、弯曲或让位的程度；弹性。
senses.en_definition: A material's flexibility or capacity to stretch.
senses.ms_definition: Sifat bahan yang boleh meregang atau melentur.
senses.nuances: 英语不可数名词，常描述布料、绳索或结构的柔韧性；马来语可用 keanjalan 或 kelenturan。

etymology.historical_story: English give has a Germanic history. Its Middle English form reflects Scandinavian influence and is related to Old English giefan or gifan. The modern word extends beyond handing over objects to granting permission, causing effects, and yielding under pressure. Its appearance inside Malay conversation is code-switching rather than evidence of a Malay root. [Source: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/give).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 give 想成“把东西递出去”：实物递出去是给予，机会递出去是提供；读 /ɡɪv/，末尾 e 不发音。

morphology.pattern_note: 在咖啡店点单语境中作为完整借入成分使用，不作马来语词缀拆分。通常按一个音节理解；所列 /ɡaw/ 是当地常见读法的宽式近似，不是已核实的 DBP 标准音标，也不标注源语言声调。

senses.zh_definition: 【咖啡店口语】浓的；指咖啡、茶等饮料味道较浓或冲调浓度较高。

senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa percakapan di kopitiam, pekat atau lebih kuat rasanya, khususnya bagi kopi atau teh.

etymology.historical_story: Malaysian beverage producer Power Root explicitly identifies gao as Hokkien for thick. In kopitiam ordering, that idea describes a stronger drink rather than a sweeter one. Singapore's tourism board likewise explains kopi-gao as extra-strong coffee. These sources document a regional ordering term; they do not establish when it first entered Malaysian speech or official Malay vocabulary. [Power Root annual report](https://powerroot.com.my/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/Power-Root-AR25.pdf), [Singapore Tourism Board](https://www.visitsingapore.com/content/dam/MICE/Global/downloads/BT_Post_Arrival_Brochure.pdf)

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 是后附代词／附着成分，此处按字段选项归入 suffix，并非普通派生后缀。词根不变，ny 表示 [ɲ]。输入的爪夷文 ݢنتي 仅写出 ganti，未包含 -nya；此处按要求保留原值。

senses.zh_definition: 其替代者或替代品；接替前文所指之人或物的人或东西。
senses.en_definition: A replacement or substitute for the person or thing previously mentioned.
senses.ms_definition: Orang atau benda yang menjadi ganti bagi orang atau benda yang telah disebut.
senses.nuances: 由 ganti 的“替代者／替代物”义加 -nya 构成；指代对象由上下文决定，不区分英语的 his、her、its。这里是组合释义，并非把输入的 ganti 词条当作 gantinya 的独立官方释文。[DBP 的 ganti 及词族释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=gantian)

senses.ms_definition: Sesuatu yang diberikan atau dilakukan sebagai balasan, pampasan atau pengganti bagi sesuatu yang telah disebut.
senses.nuances: 常见于 sebagai gantinya，整组短语可译为“作为补偿”“作为交换”或“改为”。gantinya 本身仍以名词 ganti 为核心，不能仅因英语译作 instead 就一律标为副词。[DBP 的 ganti 释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=gantian)

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 职场讨论人事接替时，正式表达 pengganti beliau 比反复说 gantinya 更能明确指代并体现尊重。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合人事交接、物品替换和补偿安排。谈论亲友离世或感情关系时，直接说找一个 gantinya 可能显得把人视为可替换对象，应顾及语境与对方感受。

etymology.historical_story: The story of gantinya lies in everyday Malay grammar: ganti names a replacement or compensation, while attached -nya points back to someone or something already mentioned. The same root supports words for replacing, replacements and succession. This entry therefore needs no invented ancient origin; its meaning grows transparently from a productive construction. [DBP word family](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=gantian)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 ganti＝替换，再加 -nya＝前面提到的那个人或东西：gantinya 就是“接替他的那位／替代它的那个”。

morphology.pattern_note: 在马来语中作为完整借词记忆，不把 -ster 当作马来语后缀。首音节的 e 为 /e/，第二音节的 e 为 /ə/；ng 表示 /ŋ/。

etymology.historical_story: Gengster is the Malay adaptation of English gangster. Its spelling represents the borrowed word in Malay, where it functions as a complete noun. Malaysian reporting uses it for criminal gang members, while gengsterisme names their activities. Gangster films provide another familiar setting, but their fictional characters should not obscure the word's strongly negative everyday meaning.

etymology.historical_story: Gadreel belongs to the named angelic figures of Enochic literature rather than to an established Malay word family. In chapter 69, the narrative connects him with Eve's deception and humanity's knowledge of lethal weapons. This supplies a documented literary setting for the name, but does not establish a standardized Malay pronunciation or a verified ultimate etymology. [Source: 1 Enoch 69](https://sacred-texts.com/book/the-book-of-enoch/chapter-lxix).

etymology.historical_story: Gypsy developed through shortening and alteration of Egyptian, reflecting a mistaken belief about Romani origins. The name therefore records an outsider's historical misunderstanding rather than a reliable account of ancestry. It later acquired a figurative wandering sense, which can repeat stereotypes when applied casually to travellers. [Source: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/Gypsy).

etymology.historical_story: Gram belongs to the international vocabulary of metric measurement. Its history runs through French gramme and Late Latin gramma to Greek gramma, which could denote a small weight as well as a written character. Malay uses this international term in practical settings such as recipes, food labels and weighing goods. Source: [Dictionnaire de l’Académie française](https://www.dictionnaire-academie.fr/article/A9G1195).

etymology.historical_story: The cultural history of gendang extends beyond musical accompaniment. Malay dictionary entries preserve names for drum signals announcing a ruler's departure, return, or a procession. The instrument could therefore communicate public events as well as mark rhythm. This documented cultural role is clearer than any proposed ultimate origin, which is not established by the supplied evidence.

senses.en_definition: Gollum, originally named Sméagol, a fictional character corrupted by the One Ring in Tolkien's The Hobbit and The Lord of the Rings.

senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，在所给词性选项中归入 noun。不是一般表示“怪物”的马来语普通名词，也不等同于 golem。输入未提供 DBP 释义，本条马来文定义为编写释义。[人物资料及原作出处](https://tolkiengateway.net/wiki/Gollum)

etymology.historical_story: Within Tolkien's story, Gollum's name comes from the disturbing swallowing sound he makes in his throat. It is a nickname rather than his original name, Sméagol. This sound-based naming gives readers an immediate physical impression of the character, making the name especially memorable when spoken aloud. It should not be treated as a Malay word assembled from smaller meaningful parts. [Original-text reference](https://tolkiengateway.net/wiki/Gollum)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Gollum 联想到喉咙里“咕噜”一声，再连上中文名“咕噜”：声音、名字和人物一起记。

morphology.pattern_note: 外来人名，整词作为专名记忆；末尾 -el 不是马来语后缀。所列 IPA 为按拼写读出的马来语近似音，实际读音依姓名持有者及语言传统而异。无常规马来语派生词族。

senses.en_definition: Gabriel, a personal name of Hebrew origin, commonly given to males.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang yang berasal daripada bahasa Ibrani dan lazimnya digunakan sebagai nama lelaki.
senses.nuances: 专有名词，正文应写 Gabriel。具体所指由语境决定；名字本身不能证明某人的宗教或族群。此处为编纂释义，输入未提供 DBP 定义；以下为常用人名组合。

senses.zh_definition: 加百列，犹太教及基督教传统中传达神意的天使；在伊斯兰传统中对应通常称为 Jibril 的天使。
senses.en_definition: Gabriel, the angelic messenger in Jewish and Christian tradition, corresponding to Jibril in Islamic tradition.
senses.ms_definition: Nama malaikat pembawa perkhabaran Tuhan dalam tradisi Yahudi dan Kristian, yang dikenali sebagai Jibril dalam tradisi Islam.
senses.nuances: 宗教专名。马来语伊斯兰语境通常使用 Jibril，基督教语境可使用 Gabriel；叙述时应遵循相关传统的称名习惯。搭配属于宗教语境，不能套用于同名普通人。

collocations.zh: 天使加百列传达的消息
collocations.en: the message conveyed by the angel Gabriel

etymology.historical_story: Gabriel comes from Hebrew Gavriʾel. Its elements connect strength or a strong man with El, meaning God, producing interpretations such as God is my strength or man of God. The name appears in Daniel and later in Luke's account of the announcement to Mary. Its religious history helps explain its use as a personal name across languages. [University of Iowa](https://bam.sites.uiowa.edu/hello/gabriel).

etymology.historical_story: English griffin is traced through Middle English griffon and Anglo-French forms to Latin gryphus and Greek gryps. Merriam-Webster dates its English use to the fourteenth century. The creature’s combined eagle and lion anatomy gives the name its distinctive visual identity. This history concerns the English word; it does not establish an independently documented Malay borrowing. [Source: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/griffin).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到 griffin 的 /ɡrɪf/，想象一只猛禽伸爪抓住狮身：鹰头、鹰翅、狮身。画面用于记义，不是词源拆解。

senses.zh_definition: 英语姓氏 Goodwin，中文通常音译为“古德温”；作为专有名词指称具体的人，也可能出现在以该姓命名的机构或其他名称中。
senses.en_definition: An English surname, normally capitalized Goodwin; also an element in names derived from that surname.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga bahasa Inggeris yang lazimnya dieja Goodwin dan digunakan untuk merujuk kepada individu atau dalam nama yang berasaskan nama keluarga tersebut.
senses.nuances: 这是专名，不能标为已确认的正式马来语普通词，故 status 为 proper_name。noun 在此细分为 kata nama khas。没有上下文时不能确定它指哪位人物或哪家机构，也不能译成“好胜利”。马来语释义为编辑说明，搭配为常见专名句法框架，并非已验证的高频词组。姓名来源参见 [Oxford Dictionary of Family Names in Britain and Ireland](https://api.pageplace.de/preview/DT0400.9780192527479_A30390808/preview-9780192527479_A30390808.pdf)；通常读音参见 [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/goodwin)。

etymology.historical_story: Oxford’s account of English family names connects Goodwin with the Old English personal name Gōdwine, interpretable as good friend. Such personal names could become inherited surnames. The historical explanation does not make Goodwin a modern phrase meaning good victory, nor establish the ancestry of every bearer. In Malay, it functions as a name whose spelling is normally retained. See [Oxford](https://api.pageplace.de/preview/DT0400.9780192527479_A30390808/preview-9780192527479_A30390808.pdf).

senses.zh_definition: 玻璃；一种坚硬、易碎、通常透明的材料，可用于制作窗户、瓶子等物品。
senses.en_definition: A hard, brittle, usually transparent material used to make windows, bottles, and other objects.
senses.ms_definition: Bahan keras dan rapuh yang biasanya lut sinar serta digunakan untuk membuat tingkap, botol dan pelbagai barang; kaca.
senses.nuances: 此处是英语词义，不能据此认定 glass 是正式马来语词条；马来语通常使用 kaca。马来语释义为编辑释义。英语中该材料义通常不可数，名词前的 glass 可表示“玻璃制的”。所列搭配是英语成分嵌入马来语的表达。[Cambridge Dictionary：glass](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/glass)

senses.zh_definition: 玻璃杯；也可指一玻璃杯所盛的饮料或其容量。
senses.en_definition: A drinking vessel made of glass, or the amount of liquid it holds.
senses.ms_definition: Bekas minuman yang diperbuat daripada kaca, atau jumlah minuman yang dimuatkan di dalamnya; gelas atau segelas minuman.
senses.nuances: 此为英语可数名词义。在马来语中，杯子通常称 gelas，一杯饮料用 segelas 表达；不要把英语 glass 的拼写当作马来语 gelas 的标准拼写。下列为语码混用表达，正式马来语宜使用 gelas。[Cambridge Dictionary：glass](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/glass)

etymology.historical_story: English glass continues Middle English glas and Old English glæs. Its history therefore belongs to English rather than to Malay affixation. The material name also serves for a vessel made from that material. When it appears inside a Malay sentence, context determines whether kaca or gelas is the appropriate standard equivalent. [Merriam-Webster: glass](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/glass)

etymology.historical_story: English guard developed through French forms associated with keeping watch and protecting. In Malaysian conversation, the English noun can appear inside otherwise Malay sentences, particularly when referring to building security staff. That conversational use must be distinguished from dictionary recognition: DBP's English–Malay dictionary supplies pengawal as its Malay equivalent. The packet does not establish when local use began. [English etymology](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/guard) [DBP equivalent](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=wadar)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 guard，就想到门口“把关”的人；正式马来语记作 pengawal keselamatan。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 首次正式联系时，使用对方认可的称谓及姓名，如 Encik Greene；称谓应根据本人身份和偏好选择。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于提及确实使用该姓氏的人物。正式名单、邮件和引文应保留 Greene 的大写及末尾 e；不要擅自改成 Green 或翻译成 hijau。

etymology.historical_story: Surname references identify Greene as a variant of Green, while English dictionaries record several people bearing it. A Malay text can therefore contain Greene simply by mentioning a person, without borrowing it as an ordinary word. Its final e remains part of the name even though the pronunciation matches green, making spelling important in correspondence and attribution. [Surname reference](https://surnames.behindthename.com/name/greene); [pronunciation](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/pronunciation/english/greene).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Greene 与英语 green 同音，但姓名末尾多一个不发音的 e：听到 /ɡriːn/，写名字时记得核对结尾。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词借入，现代马来语中不拆作词根与词缀。依资料中的 gé.ne.sis，首音为 /ɡ/，首个 e 为 /e/。未列未经核实的马来语派生词。

senses.zh_definition: 事物、思想或文明等的起源、发端或最初形成的起点。
senses.en_definition: The origin or initial emergence of something, especially an idea or civilization.
senses.ms_definition: Titik permulaan atau asal usul sesuatu, seperti idea atau tamadun.
senses.nuances: 偏学术或书面，着重追溯某事物如何开始形成；日常通常说 asal usul 或 permulaan。一般名词 genesis 与英语圣经书名 Genesis 须按语境区分；后者通常译为 Kitab Kejadian。本义依据输入的《Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat》释义。

dual_scenarios.zh: 这项研究通过相关人物之间的通信，追溯该思想的起源。
dual_scenarios.en: This study traces the genesis of the idea through correspondence between the people involved.

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 讨论思想或文明的起源时，应区分已有证据与推测。谈宗教文本时，使用相关群体采用的书名，避免把普通名词与专名混为一谈。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 讨论思想或文明的起源时，应区分已有证据与推测。谈宗教文本时，使用相关群体采用的书名，避免把普通名词与专名混为一谈。

etymology.historical_story: Genesis ultimately comes from Greek genesis, associated with birth, creation, and coming into being. That image explains why a word about birth can describe the emergence of an idea or civilization. Malay records this abstract meaning, but the supplied evidence does not establish the immediate language through which Malay borrowed it. [Oxford](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/genesis).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ge-ne-sis 连成一颗种子逐渐萌芽的画面：追问它最初怎样出现，就是追溯 genesis。此为意象记忆，不是构词拆解。

morphology.pattern_note: 本词不作词缀拆分；词末书写的 k 在常见马来西亚发音中实现为喉塞音 [ʔ]。数据包未提供音节字段，保留 null。

senses.zh_definition: 列车中连接编组、供载客或运货使用的车厢，通常由机车牵引，本身不提供牵引动力。
senses.en_definition: A railway carriage or wagon coupled into a train to carry passengers or goods.
senses.ms_definition: Kereta atau pedati yang disambung-sambung pada kereta api; gerbong.
senses.nuances: 指列车的一节车厢，不指机车，也通常不指整列火车。客运语境中也常见 koc；货运语境宜明确货物类型。本条处理数据包所指的铁路义。参见 [DBP PRPM：gerabak](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=gerabak)。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary definition preserves an older transport image: a pedati, or cart, joined to a train. This provides a useful cultural bridge between road haulage and railway transport. Modern compounds distinguish passenger carriages, freight wagons and tank wagons. The available evidence supports this semantic connection, but does not establish a particular borrowing route or date.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ge-ra-bak 的三拍想成三节相连车厢；末尾 [ʔ] 像车厢接合时突然收住的一拍。此为记忆联想，并非词源。

morphology.pattern_note: 按构词分析，-an 将 gencat 名词化；词根末尾 t 在加后缀后成为下一音节的声母，形成 gen.ca.tan。数据包将整个 gencatan 标为词根，此处作形态分析修正。现代常用表达是 gencatan senjata。

word_family.gloss: 停火；含派生名词的固定词组

senses.zh_definition: 主要用于 gencatan senjata，指交战或交火停止的状态，或交战各方停止战斗、射击的协议。
senses.en_definition: Chiefly in gencatan senjata: a cessation of fighting or an agreement to stop hostilities; a ceasefire.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam frasa gencatan senjata atau gencatan perang, keadaan berhenti bertempur atau persetujuan menghentikan pertempuran atau tembak-menembak.
senses.nuances: 通常以固定搭配 gencatan senjata 出现，不宜当作适用于所有活动的泛指“暂停”。停火可以有期限，也可能遭到违反；该词本身不表示投降、永久和平或冲突已经解决。

dual_scenarios.en: Both sides agreed to implement a 48-hour ceasefire to allow humanitarian aid to be delivered.

etymology.historical_story: Gencatan is most familiar through the diplomatic expression gencatan senjata. Its structure links the idea of stopping with senjata, meaning weapons, while the phrase names a halt in fighting rather than the physical disappearance of weapons. This distinction matters in news reporting: a ceasefire can create space for negotiations or relief without establishing lasting peace. The supplied evidence gives no dated origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gencatan senjata 整组记成“让武器停下来”：senjata 是武器，整个词组就是“停火”。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根本身无词缀；添加 meN- 或 peN- 时，前缀分别实现为 meng-、peng-，词根首音 g 保留：menggodam、penggodam。

word_family.gloss: 用大锤重击；侵入电脑系统

senses.zh_definition: 用于重击、敲碎或拆除的大锤。
senses.en_definition: A large, heavy hammer used for forceful striking or breaking.
senses.ms_definition: Palu, tukul atau martil yang besar.
senses.nuances: 指需要较大冲击力的重型工具，不能泛指所有小锤；palu godam 是明确指称大锤的常见组合。

senses.zh_definition: 用大锤等工具猛击或砸击；godam 可见于命令句及口语，正式主动陈述通常用 menggodam。
senses.en_definition: To strike heavily with a sledgehammer or similar implement; a bare verb form used in commands and informal speech.
senses.ms_definition: Menghentam atau memukul dengan godam atau alat seumpamanya; bentuk berimbuhnya ialah menggodam.
senses.nuances: 与工具名词义相连，强调重击。godam batu 这样的无前缀形式需结合命令句或口语语境理解，不宜直接套入所有正式主动句。

collocations.en: smash a rock with a sledgehammer
break a wall with a sledgehammer

senses.zh_definition: 侵入电脑系统或网络账户，通常指未经许可取得访问权限。
senses.en_definition: To hack into a computer system or online account, typically without authorization.
senses.ms_definition: Menceroboh masuk ke dalam sistem komputer pihak lain untuk mendapatkan akses kepada data atau maklumat; bentuk berimbuhnya ialah menggodam.
senses.nuances: 口语常说 kena godam，正式文字通常用 digodam 或 menggodam。不能把所有登录故障都称为遭入侵；penggodam 也不能脱离语境一概译成网络罪犯。[DBP：penggodam](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=penggodam)。

etymology.historical_story: Godam names a heavy hammer, while menggodam also denotes breaking into computer systems. These meanings offer a memorable bridge between physical force and digital intrusion: a barrier is overcome in each case. This is a comparison of the recorded senses, not a verified account of the word's ultimate origin or the date its computing meaning arose.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 go.dam 时想象大锤落下的“咚”声：砸开实体障碍是重击，突破数字屏障则联想到 menggodam。此为记忆联想，不是词源解释。

morphology.formula: ∅ + glen → glen（英语整词；未确认是规范马来语词目）
morphology.pattern_note: 所列音标属于英语词 glen。不可把它拆成马来语词缀与词根；没有可靠依据建立其马来语派生词族。

senses.zh_definition: 英语地理词：狭窄、通常较幽静的山谷，尤用于苏格兰或爱尔兰景观。
senses.en_definition: A narrow, secluded valley, especially in Scotland or Ireland.
senses.ms_definition: Istilah bahasa Inggeris bagi lembah yang sempit dan terpencil, khususnya dalam gambaran landskap Scotland atau Ireland.
senses.nuances: 这是已核实的英语义项，不能据此认定 glen 是 DBP 认可的马来语普通名词。此处马来语定义为说明性翻译，搭配栏提供马来语对应表达。若原文中的 Glen 是人名或地名，须按专名另行识别。[Merriam-Webster：glen](https://scrabble.m-w.com/dictionary/glen)

collocations.en: a secluded valley; a secluded glen

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 若 Glen 是人名，保留本人使用的拼写与称呼；不要把人名直接翻译成“山谷”。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 马来语说明文中可先解释 glen 的英语含义，再使用 lembah sempit。专名通常须大写，不能仅凭小写词频记录推断其具体所指。

etymology.historical_story: English glen came through Scots from Scottish Gaelic and Irish gleann, with an older Irish form glenn. Its landscape meaning helps explain its association with Scotland and Ireland. Merriam-Webster dates its first known English use to the fifteenth century. This history establishes the English word’s background; it does not establish glen as a standard Malay borrowing. [Merriam-Webster: glen](https://scrabble.m-w.com/dictionary/glen)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 glen，就想象两座山夹着一条窄谷；马来语用 lembah sempit 来理解。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语 grant 的整词借入形式，现代马来语中不拆作词缀。首音节 e 读 /ə/；常用相关形式多为复合词，下列词族项目不是加缀派生词。

senses.zh_definition: 证明土地或房产所有权的文件；地契或产权证。
senses.en_definition: A document certifying ownership of land or property; a title deed.
senses.ms_definition: Surat hak milik tanah, rumah dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 资料包中的核心义以土地所有权文件为中心。具体搭配会说明所涉及的财产；这里指权属文件，不指资助款。[DBP 释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=273844&keyword=geran)

collocations.en: a copy of the title deed

senses.zh_definition: 车辆登记或所有权证明文件，日常常称车契。
senses.en_definition: A vehicle registration or ownership document, commonly called a vehicle title.
senses.ms_definition: Dokumen pendaftaran atau pemilikan kenderaan, yang lazim disebut geran kenderaan.
senses.nuances: geran kereta 和 geran motor 是常见日常说法。正式文件须按实际证件名称使用 Perakuan Pendaftaran Kenderaan 或 Sijil Pemilikan Kenderaan；不能将它理解为路税或驾驶执照。[JPJ 官方证件说明](https://www.jpj.gov.my/kenyataan-media-rasmi-2016/)

senses.zh_definition: 由政府、机构等为研究、教育、商业发展或其他指定用途提供的资助款。
senses.en_definition: Funding awarded by a government or institution for a specified purpose; a grant.
senses.ms_definition: Bantuan kewangan yang diberikan oleh kerajaan atau institusi untuk membiayai sesuatu tujuan atau projek.
senses.nuances: 常与 penyelidikan、pendidikan、perniagaan 等词搭配。通常属于资助而非普通贷款；是否附带配套出资、成果或款项退还条件，取决于具体计划。本义在政府与大学的正式用语中广泛使用。[马来西亚教育部资助用语](https://www.moe.gov.my/index.php/bantuan-geran-per-kapita-pcg)

etymology.historical_story: Geran is an established Malay borrowing corresponding to English grant. DBP’s terminology guide explicitly lists this pairing among familiar foreign terms retained in Malay. Its meanings offer a useful connection: an institution may grant a right, documented in a title, or grant financial assistance. Context determines whether the conversation concerns ownership papers or project funding. [DBP terminology guide](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/umum_istilah.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把英语 grant 与 geran 连起来记：tanah 提醒你想到地契，kereta 提醒你想到车契，penyelidikan 提醒你想到研究资助。

morphology.pattern_note: 独立词根，无词缀；词尾 ng 表示单一鼻音 /ŋ/。派生时 meN- 在 g 前实现为 meng-，保留 g，如 menggarang。

senses.zh_definition: 凶猛的；凶巴巴的；形容动物容易攻击，或人态度严厉、容易动怒而令人畏惧。
senses.en_definition: Fierce or aggressive; stern and intimidating in manner.
senses.ms_definition: Suka atau lekas menyerang dan sebagainya apabila marah; bengis atau galak.
senses.nuances: 形容动物时侧重攻击性；形容老师、父母或上司时可指严厉的表情、语气或管教方式，不必然表示残暴。tegas 侧重立场坚定，通常比 garang 更中性。[DBP 释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=garang)。

senses.zh_definition: 特别喜爱某事的；做某事劲头很足的。
senses.en_definition: Very fond of something; keen or voracious.
senses.ms_definition: Suka atau gemar akan sesuatu; dalam ungkapan garang makan, kuat makan.
senses.nuances: DBP 标为 Mn，即米南加保用法；不宜当作马来西亚日常标准语中所有语境都通用的“喜欢”。以下搭配限于该地域义或相应叙述语境。

senses.en_definition: Strong or fierce, especially of wind.
senses.ms_definition: Kencang atau hebat, terutama tentang angin.
senses.nuances: 带描写性，常见于文学、新闻特写或强调自然力量的表达。普通天气说明中 angin kencang 更常用。

senses.zh_definition: 鲜亮夺目的；浓艳醒目的，指颜色。
senses.en_definition: Vivid, intense, and striking in colour.
senses.ms_definition: Terang, bercahaya atau sangat cerah, berkenaan dengan warna.
senses.nuances: 描述颜色的视觉冲击力，可表示欣赏，也可暗示过于抢眼；不自动等于俗艳或难看。

etymology.historical_story: Garang is an established Malay root whose deeper origin is not securely established here. Its dictionary meanings connect intimidating behaviour, powerful wind, and striking colour. A useful semantic image is intensity that commands attention: a fierce dog, a stern teacher, a forceful gust, or brilliant red. This connection is a learning interpretation, not a documented historical sequence.

senses.zh_definition: 双子座：黄道附近的一个星座，以双胞胎形象命名。
senses.en_definition: A constellation near the ecliptic, traditionally represented as twins.
senses.ms_definition: Buruj berhampiran ekliptik yang secara tradisional dilambangkan oleh sepasang kembar.
senses.nuances: 这是天文学中的星座用法，须与占星学的黄道宫位区分；此处马来语释义为编写释义，并非逐字引自输入包。专名的具体含义仍取决于语境。[NASA：Origins of NASA Names](https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/sp-4402.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Gemini means twins in Latin. The celestial name is associated with Castor and Pollux, linking a familiar pair of stars with the image of two companions. NASA later chose Gemini for its two-person spaceflight programme, showing how the same name could connect an ancient sky tradition with a modern technological project. Malay retains the name as a complete borrowed form. [NASA naming history](https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/sp-4402.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Gemini 的 ge-mi-ni 三拍，配上一对并肩的双胞胎：看到这个名字，就想到“双子”。

morphology.pattern_note: -kan 表示使动，词根读音不变。goyangkan 常用于祈使句及第一、第二人称被动结构；一般主动陈述用 menggoyangkan。输入 Jawi ݢويڠ 对应词根 goyang，并未包含 -kan。

senses.zh_definition: 使物体或身体部位来回摇动、摆动。
senses.en_definition: To cause something to shake, sway, or rock.
senses.ms_definition: Menggerakkan sesuatu supaya berayun atau bergoncang.
senses.nuances: 强调使某物产生摆动；力度由语境决定，不必然是猛烈摇晃。直接指令可用 goyangkan；陈述某人正在做此动作通常用 menggoyangkan。释义依据 [DBP：goyang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243152&keyword=goyang)。

senses.zh_definition: 使信心、立场或地位变得不坚定；动摇。
senses.en_definition: To undermine confidence, resolve, or an established position.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadikan keyakinan, pendirian atau kedudukan tidak lagi teguh.
senses.nuances: 属于抽象引申义。goyangkan 可出现在 jangan 等引导的句式中；新闻中的普通主动陈述通常采用 menggoyangkan。不能把所有一般性的改变都称为动摇。

etymology.historical_story: A cultural illustration comes from kuih goyang, also called kuih loyang or kuih ros. Its flower-shaped mould is dipped into batter and hot oil, then shaken to release the biscuit. The name preserves the visible action of goyang. Goyangkan adds the productive Malay causative suffix -kan to that movement word. [JKKN：Kuih Loyang](https://pemetaanbudaya.jkkn.gov.my/senibudaya/detail/1329)。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 goyang 想成来回摆动的摇篮；加上 -kan，就是让它摇起来。

morphology.formula: bagaimana → gimana（口语缩略；非词缀派生）
morphology.pattern_note: 来自 bagaimana 的口语缩略，省去开头的 ba- 并压缩内部音节；这不是可推广到其他词的规则性加缀过程。音标按拼写作宽式标示。

word_family.gloss: 完整标准形式：怎样；如何
由完整形式加疑问语气词构成：究竟如何

senses.zh_definition: 怎样；如何；怎么样。用于口语询问方式、情况或解决办法。
senses.en_definition: How; in what way or condition; a colloquial shortened form of bagaimana.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk singkat bahasa percakapan bagi bagaimana, untuk menanyakan cara, keadaan atau tindakan yang patut dilakukan.
senses.nuances: DBP 标为 bp（口语）、kep（缩略）。马来语语法通常将其归为 kata tanya；此处按所给词类选项归入 adverb。正式马来西亚马来语用 bagaimana；马来西亚日常交流也常听见 macam mana。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=gimana)

etymology.historical_story: Gimana illustrates how a frequent question can become shorter in conversation. DBP records it as a colloquial abbreviation of bagaimana, preserving the everyday question 'how?' while reducing its spoken shape. Its dictionary inclusion records usage rather than making it suitable for every register. The full form remains the appropriate choice in formal Malaysian Malay. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=gimana)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 gimana 看成 bagaimana 的“聊天压缩版”：形式缩短，问的仍是“怎样、如何”。

senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，通常首字母大写。仅凭姓名不能断定个人的宗教、国籍或语言。输入未提供可核实的 DBP 释义，本条马来文释义为编写说明；status 按指定数据格式保留为 official，不表示该姓名已获 DBP 普通词条认证。

senses.zh_definition: 伽内什，亦称伽内沙；印度教中象头人身、被信众视为消除障碍与护佑新开端的神祇。
senses.en_definition: Ganesh, also called Ganesha, the elephant-headed Hindu deity associated with removing obstacles and new beginnings.
senses.ms_definition: Ganesh atau Ganesha, dewa berkepala gajah dalam agama Hindu yang dipercayai oleh penganutnya dapat menghilangkan halangan dan membawa keberkatan pada permulaan sesuatu usaha.
senses.nuances: 这是宗教专名，须与同名人物区分。有关神力的表述属于信仰内容。[宗教与艺术背景：大都会艺术博物馆](https://www.metmuseum.org/exhibitions/ganesha)。

etymology.historical_story: Ganesh is a form of the name Ganesha, an elephant-headed Hindu deity associated with overcoming obstacles and beginning new ventures. The Met documents depictions spanning India, the Himalayas and Southeast Asia. In present-day communication, the same name may identify a person, so context determines the reference. [Source: The Met](https://www.metmuseum.org/exhibitions/ganesha).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Ganesh 与常见形式 Ganesha 连起来，再联想象头神的形象；遇到 Encik Ganesh，则先理解为人名。

senses.en_definition: An English surname also used as a given name.

senses.nuances: 词性为专有名词，正常行文写作 Grayson。此为姓名说明，并非 DBP 官方马来语释义；资料包不足以确定具体人物，也不能排除地名等其他专名用途。IPA 为英语参考读音，排名仅沿用资料包。以下为示范性姓名短语，不宣称是经语料统计的高频搭配。

etymology.historical_story: Grayson has an English surname history before its use as a given name. The Dictionary of American Family Names connects northern English examples with Graveson, referring to the son of a steward, farm bailiff, or village headman; it also notes a possible place-name origin. This history does not establish the ancestry of any individual bearer or create a Malay word meaning.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 英语读音近‘格雷森’，重音在前；把它整体记作人名，不按马来语词缀拆解。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词作为独立词素记忆，单音节；不是 gula 的缩写。下列词族项是固定复合名称，不是加缀派生词。

word_family.gloss: 昙花；夜间开放的花卉名称

senses.en_definition: An archaic or classical Malay word for a rose.
