senses.nuances: 输入中的 ark、sl 分别标示古语和古典文学用语；现代日常交流通常用 bunga ros 或 bunga mawar。下列为文学性组合，不能据此声称它们是现代高频搭配。

etymology.historical_story: Gul is a Persian loanword meaning rose, documented among Persian botanical terms borrowed into Malay. Its survival connects Malay vocabulary with a wider history of language contact. In present-day learning, its classical meaning should be distinguished from the fixed name gul bakawali: that expression denotes a night-blooming cactus, not a kind of rose. Source: [NUSA linguistic study](https://sealang.net/archives/nusa/pdf/nusa-v19-p1-38.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: Ghostbusters combines ghost with busters, an English formation suggesting people who defeat or get rid of something. Its best-known cultural reference is the 1984 film, whose fictional investigators turn ghost catching into a business. The film's popularity led to sequels and other adaptations, allowing the title to become a widely recognised entertainment name. See [the Academy's Ghostbusters collection](https://www.oscars.org/collection-highlights/ghostbusters).

etymology.historical_story: English guess is recorded from the fourteenth century, through Middle English gessen. Merriam-Webster suggests a possible Scandinavian origin and compares related northern European forms, while retaining uncertainty about the precise route. Its appearance inside a Malay conversation is a separate matter: it functions there as an English insertion. Learners should therefore connect it with meneka rather than invent a Malay root or affix. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/guess)

senses.zh_definition: 由布、纸、席子、线或金属丝等卷绕而成的圆柱状物；也用于计量这类物品，表示“卷”。
senses.en_definition: A roll or coil of flexible material; a unit for counting such material.
senses.ms_definition: Benda berbentuk silinder hasil lilitan bahan berlembar atau berutas; juga digunakan sebagai unit bilangannya.
senses.nuances: 强调卷起后的形状或数量。segulung kain 为“一卷布”，dua gulung dawai 为“两卷金属丝”；不表示任意圆形物体。

senses.zh_definition: 把柔软的片状物卷成圆柱状，或把线、绳等缠绕起来。
senses.en_definition: To roll up flexible material or wind thread, rope, or similar material.
senses.ms_definition: Membentuk bahan menjadi gulungan atau melilitkan benang, tali dan sebagainya pada gelendong.
senses.nuances: 标准主动陈述句通常用 menggulung；祈使句、特定被动结构及日常口语可用 gulung，如 Gulung tikar itu。自身呈卷曲或翻滚状态通常用 bergulung。

senses.zh_definition: 总结讲话或辩论的重点，使其结束；通常以 menggulung 的形式出现。
senses.en_definition: To conclude a speech or debate by drawing together its main points.
senses.ms_definition: Menamatkan ucapan atau perbahasan dengan merumuskan perkara penting.
senses.nuances: 常见于议会、辩论赛及正式发言。不能把所有“结束”都替换成 gulung；普通活动结束通常用 tamat 或 selesai。

senses.zh_definition: 击败或压倒对手；通常以 menggulung 的形式出现。
senses.en_definition: To defeat or overwhelm an opponent.
senses.ms_definition: Mengalahkan lawan atau menundukkan musuh.
senses.nuances: 比喻义，带有强烈的胜负色彩，常用于体育报道；不是“战胜”在所有语境中的中性替代词。

senses.zh_definition: 仅见于惯用语 gulung tikar：企业或生意倒闭、歇业，常暗示经营失败。
senses.en_definition: In gulung tikar: to go out of business, typically through commercial failure.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam ungkapan gulung tikar: bankrap atau terpaksa menutup perniagaan.
senses.nuances: 这是完整短语的比喻义，不能归为 gulung 单独使用时的普遍词义。menggulung tikar 也可按语境表示收拾散场；字面义仍是卷起席子。

etymology.historical_story: Rolling a mat provides a concrete way to understand this word's figurative range. A spread mat occupies a space; rolling it gathers everything into a compact form and prepares it for removal. Malay similarly uses menggulung for drawing a debate to a close, while gulung tikar evokes business closure. This is a cultural explanation of the imagery, not a documented account of when these expressions originated.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 gu-lung 时想象双手把席子“咕噜”卷起：gulung 是卷，gulung tikar 还可联想“收摊关门”。此为助记，不是词源。

etymology.historical_story: Malay gosip reflects English gossip. The English word has a surprisingly social ancestry: Old English godsibb referred to a godparent, a person linked through baptism rather than blood. Its meanings later included a close companion and then someone associated with personal chatter. Modern Malay uses the borrowed form for talk about other people's affairs. English ancestry: [American Heritage Dictionary](https://ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=gossip).

etymology.historical_story: A memorable cultural link appears in kuih goyang, a traditional Malaysian rosette cookie. The cook dips a heated mould into batter, lowers it into hot oil, then shakes it to release the cookie. Here goyang names a practical movement in food preparation. This explains the culinary name, without establishing the deeper historical origin of the root. Source: [JKKN cultural account](https://pemetaanbudaya.jkkn.gov.my/senibudaya/detail/1329).

etymology.historical_story: Gil corresponds to English gill, an older liquid measure preserved in recipes and historical measurement tables. Its defining relationship is simple: four gills make one pint. The cultural complication lies in the pint itself, whose capacity differs between systems. Reading an old recipe therefore requires identifying its measurement tradition before converting the quantity into modern metric units.

etymology.historical_story: Georgie belongs to an English naming tradition in which familiar forms express affection or closeness. It is used for names such as George and Georgia. The underlying George family ultimately connects with Greek words for farming and working the earth. That historical association explains the name's ancestry, rather than a person's occupation. [Sources: Georgie](https://www.behindthename.com/name/georgie), [George](https://www.behindthename.com/name/george).

etymology.historical_story: Gibbs is an English and Scottish surname explained as meaning son of Gib. This preserves an older naming practice in which a parent's familiar name helped identify a family line. When used in Malay, the surname is normally carried over intact: its historical structure does not create productive Malay prefixes or suffixes. [Source: Gibbs surname](https://surnames.behindthename.com/name/gibbs).

etymology.historical_story: The packet provides no definition, source context, pronunciation, or Jawi spelling for this form. A separate Scots dictionary records goldie for several unrelated referents, illustrating why spelling alone cannot establish the intended Malay meaning. That evidence does not demonstrate borrowing into Malay. The entry therefore remains unresolved until its original sentence or a reliable Malay attestation becomes available. [Scottish National Dictionary](https://dsl.ac.uk/entry/snd/goldie)

senses.zh_definition: 气泡；液体中、液面上或由薄液膜包围气体形成的小泡，包括肥皂泡。
senses.en_definition: A bubble of gas in a liquid or enclosed by a thin liquid film.
senses.ms_definition: Bebola kecil berisi gas yang terdapat dalam cecair, timbul pada permukaannya atau terbentuk daripada lapisan air sabun.
senses.nuances: 可指单个泡；buih 通常更侧重成片泡沫。沸水冒泡也可用本词，不宜一律译成“肥皂泡”。释义综合 DBP 所收词义重新表述。[DBP：gelembung](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=gelembung)

senses.zh_definition: 材料内部封存空气或其他气体形成的小空腔、气孔。
senses.en_definition: A gas-filled cavity trapped within a solidified material.
senses.ms_definition: Lompang berisi udara dalam bahan yang telah membeku atau mengeras.
senses.nuances: 指被困在材料内部的气泡或空腔，不一定浮动，也不一定肉眼可见。可用于玻璃、冰或凝固材料。

senses.zh_definition: 气球；用薄橡胶等材料制成、充气后供玩耍的球状物。
senses.en_definition: An inflatable rubber toy; a balloon.
senses.ms_definition: Bebola getah nipis yang diisi udara untuk permainan; belon.
senses.nuances: DBP 收录此义，也用 gelembungan。马来西亚日常交流通常用 belon 更明确，以免被理解为液体中的气泡。

etymology.historical_story: Gelembung connects a familiar childhood activity with the language of materials: soap bubbles, bubbles rising through liquid, and air pockets in hardened substances share a visible enclosed shape. DBP also records a balloon sense. These related meanings provide a useful cultural and conceptual story, but the cited entry does not establish a deeper historical derivation. [DBP entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=gelembung)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按 ge.lem.bung 三节念，想象泡泡逐渐鼓起，最后在 bung 处“啵”地破掉；词尾 /ŋ/ 像把声音封在泡里。

word_family.gloss: 使发痒、发笑或感到恶心，视语境而定
发痒、发笑或恶心的感觉

senses.zh_definition: 受搔弄或轻触时发痒、忍不住想笑的；怕痒的。
senses.en_definition: Ticklish; experiencing the sensation caused by tickling or light touch.
senses.ms_definition: Berasa seperti apabila digeletek, biasanya sehingga hendak ketawa.
senses.nuances: 表示搔痒引起的特殊感觉，不等同于蚊虫叮咬或皮肤病造成的 gatal。以下各义及末项同形词依据 [DBP《Kamus Dewan》与《Kamus Pelajar》](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=169476&keyword=geli)。

senses.zh_definition: 觉得滑稽而想笑的；被逗乐的。
senses.en_definition: Amused and inclined to laugh at something funny.
senses.ms_definition: Berasa hendak ketawa kerana sesuatu yang lucu atau jenaka.
senses.nuances: geli hati 明确表示觉得好笑。单独说 geli 也可能被理解为恶心，因此谈笑话时加 hati 更清楚。

senses.zh_definition: 因刺耳声响等刺激而感到酸麻、难受或毛骨悚然的。
senses.en_definition: Experiencing an unpleasant shudder or a teeth-on-edge sensation, especially at a grating sound.
senses.ms_definition: Berasa ngilu atau ngeri, misalnya apabila mendengar bunyi besi dikikir.
senses.nuances: 强调令人发颤的感官不适，不一定涉及肮脏、恐惧或疼痛。

collocations.zh: 听到摩擦声觉得浑身难受

senses.zh_definition: 见到水蛭、蠕虫等事物时，既嫌恶又发怵的。
senses.en_definition: Squeamish or creeped out by something such as leeches or worms.
senses.ms_definition: Berasa jijik dan seram apabila melihat sesuatu seperti ular, lintah atau cacing.
senses.nuances: 可以同时包含嫌恶与害怕；不必意味着对象肮脏、有毒或真的危险。

senses.zh_definition: 因看见或闻到肮脏、腐臭的东西而感到恶心、反胃的。
senses.en_definition: Disgusted or nauseated by the sight or smell of something dirty or foul.
senses.ms_definition: Berasa jijik, mual atau loya apabila melihat atau menghidu sesuatu yang kotor dan busuk.
senses.nuances: 比一般的“不喜欢”更强烈。用于评价别人的食物、身体或习惯时容易构成侮辱。

collocations.zh: 看到生蛆的垃圾觉得恶心

senses.en_definition: A kidney, in the uncommon expressions buah geli and geli-geli.
senses.ms_definition: Buah pinggang; ginjal, dalam bentuk buah geli atau geli-geli.
senses.nuances: 这是 DBP 另列的同形词 geli II，与怕痒、好笑或恶心各义分开处理。以下是词典记录的罕用形式，并非现代高频搭配；现代一般使用 buah pinggang。[DBP 同形词记录](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=169476&keyword=geli)

etymology.historical_story: Geli brings several bodily reactions into one everyday word: ticklish laughter, amusement, shuddering and disgust. Malay dictionaries document this range, but it does not establish which meaning came first. The expression geli hati gives laughter a clear verbal home, while references to worms or unpleasant smells guide listeners towards squeamishness or nausea. [Dictionary evidence](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=169476&keyword=geli).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人轻挠你，你“咯咯”笑：geli 可以是怕痒；加 hati 是觉得好笑，遇到虫或臭味则可能是发怵、恶心。

raw_prpm.kamus_dewan: [ge.ri.la]  | ݢريلا Definisi : 1. = perang ~ perang secara kecil-kecilan dan tidak berhadap-hadapan; 2. = pasukan ~ pasukan yg menjalankan perang gerila. (Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat)
raw_prpm.kamus_pelajar: [ge.ri.la]  | ݢريلا Definisi : 1 = perang ~ peperangan tidak rasmi yg dilakukan secara tiba-tiba dan bersembunyi-sembunyi. 2 orang yg menjalankan peperangan tidak rasmi secara tiba-tiba dan bersembunyi-sembunyi. pasukan ~ pasukan yg terdiri drpd gerila dan yg menjalankan perang gerila. (Kamus Pelajar Edisi Kedua)
